chunks: Rijal al-Kashi: Muhammad b. Qulawayh and al-Husayn b. al-Hasan b. Bundar together from Sa’d from al-Yaqtini from Yunus b. Abd al-Rahman … he said: Hisham b. al-Hakam narrated to me that he heard Aba Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying:
Do not accept a narration on our authority except that which is in agreement with the Qur’an and the Sunna …
ai.seo_question: How to verify if a hadith is authentic according to the Imams?
ai.summary: In this narration from Al-Kashi’s *Rijal*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) establishes a critical criterion for validating hadith by requiring them to conform to the Qur’an and the Sunna, a principle central to Shia usul al-fiqh. This instruction underscores the inseparable link between the Imam’s teachings and the divine revelation, ensuring that prophetic traditions remain anchored in the Qur’anic framework. It serves as a foundational method for distinguishing authentic narrations from those that may have been altered or fabricated over time.
